description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'ShopProductImageUrlTag' used to generate product image URLs dynamically based on merchant store data and request parameters. It constructs image URLs for products, handling different image sizes and incorporating configuration settings.

classes.name: ShopProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class for generating product image URLs based on store configuration and request parameters.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the product image URL based on parameters, store info, and configuration, then writes it to the JSP output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the custom tag evaluation, continuing page processing.
